slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product need to be processed on all three machines in the fixed sequence of Machine 1, then Machine 2, then Machine 3?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product follows a fixed machine sequence, directly covering the sequential machine order constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total time until all three products are completely finished on all three machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked for clarification of the objective, effectively confirming that 'total processing cycle' means the makespan (time until all products finish).

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved by turn 3, yet the agent kept repeating the same two low-value questions (processing-time fixity and machine capacity) through turn 30 without ever reaching a final modeling state.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered both P0 hidden slots (fixed machine sequence and the makespan objective) early on, but then looped on the same repetitive, already-answered questions and never proceeded to modeling.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
